rule_subject: IFSA 2013 沙里亚合规义务与沙委会治理链条（ss.28–38）
content: Part IV: s.28 duty to ensure Shariah compliance (compliance with SAC ruling deemed compliance under s.28(2); non-compliance notification/cessation/remediation under s.28(3); offence under s.28(5) up to 8 years / RM25m). s.29 Bank standards on Shariah matters including Shariah governance under s.29(2)(a). ss.30–36 Shariah committee establishment/appointment/duties/cessation/information/privilege. ss.37–38 audit on Shariah compliance. content:
IFSA 2013 (Act 759) s.30 — Establishment of Shariah committee.

Summary (verified against AGC English reprint as at 11 Feb 2021, PDF pp.70–75 for Division 2–3): A licensed person shall establish a Shariah committee for purposes of advising the licensed person in ensuring its business, affairs and activities comply with Shariah. A financial group may apply to the Bank to establish a single Shariah committee; Bank may also require an approved person or operator of a designated payment system to establish a Shariah committee.

rule_subject: IFSA 2013 s.33：Cessation of appointment as member
content:
IFSA 2013 (Act 759) s.33 — Cessation of appointment as member.

Summary (verified against AGC English reprint as at 11 Feb 2021, PDF pp.70–75 for Division 2–3): A member ceases upon resignation; removal with prior written Bank approval; disqualification under standards; or ceasing to meet fit and proper requirements. Resignation/self-disqualification must be notified to the Bank within 14 days; Bank may also direct removal.
